structured.approach: I followed the backend-steps BE-04 procedure. First I read the six contracted inputs. feat.tasks and feat.design B3 were read in full. For feat.trd and feat.prd I searched only the Backend parts: IF-5, IF-6, C-6, C-7, F-10, T-8 to T-11, R-1, R-7, and AC-13 to AC-18. Then I read the ap_aging code: aging.py, __init__.py, ci.py, README.md and the file list. The step blocks shell commands, so I used Read and Glob, and checked that the files match the tool view. I mapped each Backend task (TSK-05, TSK-06) to the smallest set of components. The design adds new code only to aging.py and __init__.py, plus one new test file. It reuses days_past_due and the paid test from aging_buckets, does not use bucket_for, and adds no layer, transport, database or CI change. I wrote task.components.md and ran the verifier subagent. It found no wrong numbers and no contradictions. I fixed the five wording and citation gaps it reported: references to step IDs not in the inputs, a reason for the test-file split that was not in the source, and missing citations to feat.design B3.5.

claims.text: The Backend lane has two tasks in ap_aging: TSK-05 (STORY-05, size M) and TSK-06 (STORY-06, size S).
Only two source files change, src/ap_aging/aging.py and src/ap_aging/__init__.py, plus one new test file, tests/test_overdue.py.

In aging.py the change adds the constants OVERDUE_AFTER_DAYS = 30 and TWO_PLACES = Decimal("0.01"), the new pure functions overdue_with_risk and overdue_rows_to_json, import json, and List typing. BUCKETS, days_past_due, bucket_for and aging_buckets stay unchanged.
bucket_for(30) returns "31-60" because its "1-30" branch tests days < 30. overdue_with_risk must therefore apply days > 30 itself and never call bucket_for.
overdue_with_risk reuses the existing days_past_due function and the inv.get("paid") test that aging_buckets already uses, so no new date or paid logic is needed.
A missing vendor raises KeyError naturally through inv["vendor"], so no extra validation branch is needed.
__init__.py today exports only aging_buckets with __version__ 1.4.0. It gains the two new exports and one minor version step, which TSK-05 owns.
No service, transport or database layer exists or is added. Adding a transport would re-trigger DES-01.
ci.py measures coverage on src/ap_aging with COVERAGE_MIN = 90.0 and runs static checks (no print, eval, exec or bare except; lines at most 140 characters). It needs no change for the new code.
The existing tests in tests/test_aging.py check bucket_for with 0, 31, 90 and 91, but not 30. The new test_existing_aging_unchanged pins bucket_for(30) == "31-60".
Tests use AS_OF = date(2026, 10, 25) and due dates that give days of 30, 31, 42 and 75, with the tie on 42 ordering SYN-INV-002 before SYN-INV-003.
The README lists no functions, so it needs no change.

Two differences between inputs were resolved without changing behaviour. The tests go in tests/test_overdue.py (feat.tasks), not tests/test_aging.py (feat.stories TK-05.2). The JSON amount uses the feat.design expression str(Decimal(r["amount"]).quantize(TWO_PLACES)).

open_questions: CQB-1 (non-blocking): the exact next ap_aging version number. Interim answer: one minor step from 1.4.0, proposed in the coding step for the lane to confirm.

CQB-2 (non-blocking, carried): TQ-3 (approval of CT-1 and who owns serialisation), TQ-9 (KeyError for a missing vendor), PQ-2 (sort tie-break), DQ-2 (rounding mode), RAQ-1 (one feature/story branch for both stories). The interim answers in feat.design, feat.trd and task.repo_access apply.
